name: dev-stack
description: Start, check and stop the local services a change needs, each on its own Node version, Doppler config and port

interface.shortDescription: Start, check and stop the local services a change needs, each on its own Node version, Doppler config and port
interface.longDescription: A devstack command that reads a workspace registry (stack.yaml), starts only the services a change needs plus their dependencies through one background process-compose server, gates each on a health check, runs services from a ticket worktree when asked, checks the Docker containers they rely on, and keeps its output to a few lines so agents can verify their work without reading whole logs.
defaultPrompt: Start the local stack for this change
Show me which local services are running
